title_zh: 约定暂不揭晓生日礼物

scenario.label_zh: 约定暂不揭晓生日礼物
scenario.goal_zh: 给出不揭晓礼物内容的线索，并约定等到生日再拆封

context_zh: 两位朋友谈论一个已包装的生日礼物；收礼人的生日是周六。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: That grin tells me you have bought something ridiculous.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Not ridiculous. Would you like a hint?

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Only if it will not spoil the surprise.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: It is something you can use outdoors. That is all you are getting before Saturday.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Fair enough. I'll leave it wrapped until my birthday.
